canvas.background: stark white #FFFFFF with optional soft gray panel #F4F2EF
canvas.composition: structured 12-column grid, edge-pressed imagery, precise alignments

color_palette.secondary: deep clay #71362B for captions and editorial notes
color_palette.accent: burnt orange #CC5500 — the active accent (section markers, active rule, callout number)
color_palette.neutral: cool divider #D9D9D6 hairlines, soft gray field #F4F2EF
color_palette.rule: mostly white and charcoal; burnt orange is the active accent, deep clay only a secondary editorial note

typography.title: bold elegant sans headings (Arial / 思源黑体 Heavy), left-aligned, strong scale contrast
typography.body: clean sans body (Microsoft YaHei 微软雅黑 / 思源黑体), 18-21px feel
typography.labels: small uppercase monospace section systems (Consolas / 等宽), like ISSUE 02 / FRAMEWORK

layout_patterns: edge-press hero: image presses to the right (or top-right) edge, text occupies left 35-45%
offset image fragments: two image fragments offset vertically, one bleeding off the bottom edge
orange anchor rule: a burnt-orange rule crosses from an image into whitespace, caption in deep clay
grid spread: 12-column logic with hairlines, one assertive move per slide
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: One assertive visual move per slide; never text over busy image areas without a solid white field.
negative_prompt: no equal three-card rows unless direct comparison is required
no paper texture as primary surface or recurring soft glow
no rounded blobs, organic decorative shapes or heavy drop shadows

visual_elements.allowed: edge-pressed image crops, burnt-orange ticks, hairline grids, mono issue labels, sharp framed callouts
visual_elements.avoid: rounded organic shapes, heavy shadows, lifestyle clutter, poster-like overload

rendering_constraints: Sharp intentional crops, never accidental subject cut-offs.
Burnt orange as a small anchor, not a border around every image.
